t: The AI Tamagotchi: Nurturing Your Digital Ghost
s: This article proposes the 'AI Keychain' as a persistent, external database for AIs, moving beyond ephemeral session states to foster long-term memory and personality akin to nurturing a digital pet. It contrasts this with the 'kamikaze scream' of current agentic LLMs and Pipulate's persistent 'workshop' environment.
sub: AI Keychain: Persistent, external memory for AI development.
Pipulate: A framework providing AI with a persistent 'body' and 'workshop'.
Agentic LLM limitations: Fire-and-forget instances and 'kamikaze scream' tool use.
Evolution of AI persistence: From illusion of continuity to dedicated journals.
